root_cause.text: The `null_blk` driver fails to release the reference counts of the fault injection configfs items (`timeout_config`, `requeue_config`, and `init_hctx_fault_config`) when a `nullbX` device is removed in `nullb_group_drop_item()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch introduces `nullb_del_fault_config()` to call `config_item_put()` on `dev->init_hctx_fault_config.group.cg_item`, `dev->requeue_config.group.cg_item`, and `dev->timeout_config.group.cg_item`, and invokes this function within `nullb_group_drop_item()` to prevent the memory leak.

agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch introduces `nullb_del_fault_config()` to call `config_item_put()` on `dev->init_hctx_fault_config.group.cg_item`, `dev->requeue_config.group.cg_item`, and `dev->timeout_config.group.cg_item`, and invokes this function within `nullb_group_drop_item()` to prevent the memory leak.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add nullb_del_fault_config to properly release configfs references during device cleanup.
intent_record.what: Added the nullb_del_fault_config function to release configfs item references, along with an empty stub for when fault configuration is disabled.
intent_record.how: Ensures that reference counts for init_hctx_fault_config, requeue_config, and timeout_config are properly decremented when deleting a nullb device, preventing reference leaks.

intent_record.intent_summary: Clean up fault injection configuration when dropping a null_blk device from configfs.
intent_record.what: Added a call to nullb_del_fault_config(dev) in nullb_group_drop_item before the config item is released.
intent_record.how: This ensures that fault injection configurations associated with the null_blk device are properly cleaned up upon device removal, preventing resource leaks.

grouping_result.intent: Clean up fault injection configuration when dropping a null_blk device from configfs.
